welcome.heading: Welcome
welcome.intro: Tools for figuring out the best way to spend your Banknotes in Last Asylum: Plague, computed live from manually harvested pack data. Every value is based on the game's own deal percentages, your weekly Banknote spend and how much each item matters to you.
welcome.rankingsDescription: Every package and pass ranked by how much value it brings for its price. A ratio of 1.0 or more = worth buying at your weekly spend.
welcome.eventsDescription: Pick an event: which of its packs to buy at your weekly spend, what to buy with its coins (in unlock order) and whether spending more on it still pays off.
welcome.choicesDescription: Pick a choice chest, a package with options, or a group you can only buy one of (e.g. calendar packs) and see which is worth the most.
welcome.spendRewardsDescription: Pick a cumulative spend-reward track and see up to which tier spending more still pays off.
welcome.itemsDescription: Tell the tool which items you don't care about and which are extra important to you. Every page uses it.
welcome.compareDescription: Pick two items with amounts: what each is worth, and the cheapest way to get it.

rankings.heading: Ranking
rankings.description: Every package and pass on sale this week, ranked by worth relative to price. Worth uses the game's own deal % values, your weekly spend and your item priorities (Item Priorities). Ratio = how a pack compares with the last Banknote of the best plan for your weekly spend: 1.0 or more = a good deal at your spend, below 1.0 = your spend has better uses (not worthless, just not among your best buys; spending more lowers that bar). "Buy / week" = how many that plan buys out of what's on sale this week ("doesn't fit" = good, but whole purchases didn't fit your exact spend; with a little more it would be in). Packs of events you haven't ticked are hidden. What to buy with event coins and diamonds: see Events. Entries containing items of unknown worth are listed below the ranking, unranked.

section.unknown: Worth unknown: contains items without a worth, so it can't be compared (not ranked)

rankings.planSummary: Best plan for your weekly spend: {purchases} different packs for {spent} of {budget} Banknotes ("Buy / week" column). What to buy with the coins and diamonds they give: see Events.
rankings.monthlyNote: Monthly purchases ({names}) count at 7/30 of their price per week.

events.heading: Events
events.description: Pick a ticked event (or the VIP Shop) to see its part of the best plan for your weekly spend: the event packs to buy, the coins they give, which shop offers to buy with them (in unlock order) and whether spending more on the event still pays off. It's the same plan as on the Ranking page, so both pages agree.
events.tickHint: Only events ticked under "Events this week" are listed.
events.selectPrompt: Select an event or shop above.
events.summaryNoPacks: Your plan buys none of this event's packs at your weekly spend.
events.bonusSection: Bonus tiers: extra rewards once enough has been spent in the shop
events.stepsHeading: How much to spend on this event
events.stepsNote: Each row is the best plan with that much spent on the event's packs, the rest of your weekly spend unchanged. Step ratio 1.0 or more = the step is at least as good as your last Banknote; below 1.0 = better spent elsewhere.
events.exceedLimitsHint: Lets the plan buy the selected event's packs as often as it likes instead of their daily limit (usually once per day), e.g. to see how far the best currency pack is worth repeating. Only possible for events whose packs can be bought beyond their limit in the game: {events}.
events.exceedNote: Event pack limits exceeded: this plan differs from the Ranking (which keeps the limits).
events.randomOffersNote: This shop only shows a random selection of its offers. Buy an offer when it shows up if it's marked "Buy" (ratio 1.0 or more: worth at least what its coins are worth to you); skip the others.

choices.heading: Best Choice Pick
choices.description: Pick a choice chest, a package with options, or a group of packages you can only buy one of (e.g. calendar packs). Its options are ranked by worth at your weekly spend and item priorities.
choices.optionsDescription: Ranked by worth — the top option is the one to pick.
choices.selectCountHintPartial: You can pick {count} of these {total} options — the top {count} above are the best picks.
choices.selectCountHintAll: You get all {total} of these options, so there's nothing to prioritize between them.
choices.optionsEmpty: This item has no choice options.
choices.groupHint: You can buy only one of these. Ranked by net gain = worth − price; ratio 1.0 or more = worth buying at your weekly spend.

spendRewards.heading: Spend Rewards
spendRewards.description: Pick a cumulative spend-reward track. For each tier: the extra Banknotes needed on top of the previous tier, what those Banknotes buy (the best packs still available at that total spend) and the tier's reward. Step ratio 1.0 or more = the step is at least as good as your last Banknote at your weekly spend.
spendRewards.empty: No spend reward tracks defined yet.
spendRewards.selectPrompt: Select a reward track above to see its tiers.
spendRewards.note: Values are in Banknotes at your weekly spend.
spendRewards.verdict: Spending more pays off up to tier {tier} ({total} Banknotes in total); beyond it, each step brings less than your last Banknote at your weekly spend.
spendRewards.verdictNone: No step beyond your weekly spend brings as much as your last Banknote does.

valuation.summary: At a weekly spend of {budget} Banknotes, your last Banknote buys {rate} points, so worth = points ÷ {rate}.
valuation.summaryUnbound: Everything worth buying this week costs only {spent} of your {budget} Banknotes; the weakest pack bought returns {rate} points per Banknote, so worth = points ÷ {rate}.

items.heading: Item Priorities
items.description: How much each item matters to you. "Don't care" counts it as worthless, "Low" at half, "High" at 1.5 times its usual worth. Only base items are listed: chests, supplies, choice chests and omni shards follow the items they contain (e.g. Antitoxin Level Supplies follow Antitoxin; Brass, Leather, Refined Iron and Tempered Steel follow Cloth). Everything follows automatically, on every page.
items.footnote: Worth = Banknotes per unit at the weekly spend set on the Ranking page. Uncertain = the game's deal % values barely determine the item (hover the info icon for why).
items.uncertainTitle: The packs barely determine this value (e.g. it only appears in one pack next to other unknown items).
items.explainUnknown: Unknown = there's nothing to base a worth on: the item isn't in any pack with a deal %, can't be derived from other items and has no recipe (or it's deliberately not modelled, like Moon Coins). It counts as 0 inside packs.
items.explainUncertain: A number with "uncertain" is the best estimate, but it rests on thin evidence: the packs barely tell it apart from other items, or it depends on a single pack. Hover the info icon for the reason. If it looks off to you, use Low or High to correct it.
items.derivedNote: made of other items; set those instead and reset this one to Normal

compare.heading: Compare
compare.description: Pick two items and amounts. You see what each is worth at your weekly spend, and the cheapest guaranteed way to get it within the chosen days (from today; weekly limits reset on Monday), including what else you get along the way.
compare.note: Random chests only count with what they guarantee.
